cards.name: line_total
cards.spec: line_total returns the item's unit_price multiplied by its quantity. Use the item's own unit_price, not the product's price.

cards.name: calculate_total
cards.spec: calculate_total sets self.total to the sum of line_total() of every item in self.saleitem_set, using each item's line_total() method, and returns that total. A sale with no items has total 0.

cards.name: in_stock
cards.spec: in_stock returns True when stock is greater than zero, otherwise False.

cards.name: reduce_stock
cards.spec: reduce_stock(product, quantity) lowers product.stock by quantity and saves the product. If quantity is greater than product.stock it raises ValueError and changes nothing.
